svg.text: cell (r, c) = row r, 16-byte chunk c
chunk c of row r goes to slot c XOR r
Each cell is 16 bytes (e.g. a float4),
so a row is 8 × 16 B = 128 B: exactly one
pass over all 32 four-byte SMEM banks.
Row 0 is unchanged (XOR 0); row 7 is reversed (XOR 7).
Every row is a different shuffle, so the 8 chunks of
one logical column end up in 8 different slots.
